correctness.rationale: Double-counting all codeword Hamming weights of any full-support k-dimensional code gives s(q-1)q^{k-1}<=4(q^k-1), hence strict s<4q/(q-1). Only support sizes up to 7,5,5,4 remain for q=2,3,4,>=5. Short supports s<=4 are unrestricted and counted by Gaussian subspace totals with coordinate inclusion-exclusion, giving [1,1,q,q(2q-1),q^4+3q^3-4q^2+q]. Independently enumerated every RREF generator matrix and every message-word on all exceptional supports: binary profiles 91,100,30 for s=5..7, ternary 200 and quaternary 162 at s=5, matching all dimensions. Checked counts of *all* RREF representatives against Gaussian totals. For q=4 applied and checked F_4 arithmetic, not mod-4 integer arithmetic. For binary s=7 moment inequality forces seven distinct nonzero columns, dimension3 and simplex, giving 7!/168=30. Support decomposition L_q(n,4)=sum_s binom(n,s)a_q(s,4) yields all n; no finite-n extrapolation.
